verdict.rationale: A secure client portal or extranet is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a firm-documented portal for matters, documents, or status. The Lowenstein x Clerky partnership is a third-party formation-workflow platform, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
